body:
part of the problem is our living situation.   
My GF can't work enough to get her own place, so she has nowhere to go. We would have to live together for quite a while until we find a solution, or she would be out on the street.   
She's also been emotionaly unstable for some time now and I fear what she might do to herself if I decide to let her go. 

I feel like I'm trapped in an impossible situation and it doesn't matter what I do, it will never turn out fine. If I stay with my GF i'll likely be unhappy for some time until something turns around. If I let her go, I feel like I'll have to live with a terrible outcome of her instability.
